_note: Paths may start with ~. Folder lists are relative to each workspace root. raw_readonly comes from the workspace rule files (see raw_source); extra_protected_dirs are ck-run additions (agent configs, skill mirrors, environments, backups). A non-empty writable_only lists the ONLY folders agents may change in that workspace (everything else there is read-only; washu: <course>/solutions and <course>/prep, one pair per course; add a pair when a course is added). All workspaces share one ledger: runs_dir. Forbidden flags and edit permissions per agent are in code (ckdispatch/guards.py, ckdispatch/flags.py), not here.

live._note: ck-run run/review --live (default below; --no-live turns it off): the agent runs in its own interactive CLI in a new Terminal window. start_timeout_s: how long to wait for the window to start the agent before falling back to headless. early_exit_s: an agent that exits this fast with an error also falls back.
live._note_v4: v4 (2026-11-05): watchdog = stall watchdog while a live run waits (stall_s = the ask size's stall_s, else stall_s here); keep_awake = caffeinate while a live run waits; close_tab_after_s = close the tab of a cleanly finished run after that many seconds (0 = never).

post_review._note: Read-only Claude review after cursor and agy auto runs (ckdispatch/postreview.py). OFF since 2026-11-05 (chalach: "no need review, since those one are for simple stupid task anyways"). The rule check still runs on every run.

asks._note: v4 asks (ckdispatch/asks.py, BUILD_SPEC_v4 section 5). required: ck-run run/review need --ask. Budgets per size (the code defaults are the same): runs (incl. fixes), parallel (live at once), reviews (S: 1 only with trigger you-asked), fixes (runs with --parent in the same ask), wall_min, timeout_s (per run, when --timeout is not given), stall_s (watchdog).
